name: Squat
description: A fundamental compound leg exercise; feet shoulder-width, drive hips back and down, then push through heels to stand.

name: Deadlift
description: Hinge at hips with neutral spine, lift barbell from ground by extending hips and knees.

name: Bench Press
description: Lie on bench, lower bar to chest, press back up to full arm extension.

name: Bent-Over Row
description: Hinge forward at hips, pull bar or dumbbells to lower ribs, squeezing shoulder blades.

name: Overhead Press
description: Press barbell or dumbbells overhead from shoulder height until arms are locked.

name: Biceps Curl
description: Curl dumbbells or barbell from thigh to shoulder level with supinated grip.

name: Tricep Dip
description: Support body on parallel bars, lower until elbows ~90°, then press back up.

name: Jump Rope
description: Continuous rope-turning jump to elevate heart rate and build coordination.

name: Running
description: Sustained forward leg drive at moderate to fast pace to improve cardiovascular fitness.

name: Swimming
description: Full-body aquatic exercise using strokes like freestyle to build endurance.

name: Burpees
description: From standing, drop to plank, perform a push-up, return to standing with a jump.

name: Mountain Climber
description: From plank position, alternate driving knees toward chest at a running pace.

name: Hamstring Stretch
description: Standing or seated, extend one leg and reach toward toes to feel stretch in back of thigh.

name: Quadriceps Stretch
description: Standing, bend one knee and pull foot toward glutes to stretch front of thigh.

name: Shoulder Stretch
description: Cross one arm across chest, use opposite arm to pull it closer.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
description: Kneel on one knee, push hips forward while keeping torso upright.

name: Chest Stretch
description: Stand in a doorway, place forearms on frame and lean forward to open chest.
